title: James Fox's 2013 door-to-door search finds a farm hand who heard a boom
place_text: Near the crash site, Varginha, Brazil

tellings.quote: I just wanted to say that I too went with Marco in 2013 and I knocked on every single door of every house within a quarter or half a mile of that crash site and we found one farm hand in 2013.

plain: In 2013 the filmmaker James Fox went to Varginha, Brazil, where a strange craft is said to have come down, and with a man named Marco Leal he knocked on "every single door of every house within a quarter or half a mile" of the crash site. Fox says, from his own search, that they found just one farm hand, who remembered hearing a loud boom, a rare local witness to the crash.
